text:
maya: Seeing a repeatable race with AsyncClient auth + httpx retries. Two concurrent requests hit 401 and both try to refresh token; retry path reuses a prepared request so it re-sends stale Authorization header. Repro in FastAPI background tasks and integration tests. Anyone seen this?

sam: Can you paste a tiny repro and logs?

maya: Minimal example below. Uses ContextVar to store token and an httpx request hook that refreshes if token missing.

```py
from contextvars import ContextVar
import httpx, asyncio
_token = ContextVar('token', default=None)
async def refresh_token():
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
    return 'tok-' + str(asyncio.get_event_loop().time())
async def auth_hook(request):
    t = _token.get()
    if not t:
        t = await refresh_token()
        _token.set(t)
    request.headers['authorization'] = f'Bearer {t}'
    return request
client = httpx.AsyncClient(event_hooks={'request': [auth_hook]})
```

maya: Logs show two refreshes then a retry that still sends old header: 

INFO refresh start
INFO refresh success tokA
WARN 401 GET /v1/generate
INFO retry attempt 1
WARN 401 GET /v1/generate
INFO refresh start
INFO refresh success tokB
ERROR request ultimately failed

sam: Looks like httpx prepares the request once and reuses it for retries, so request hooks don't run again. Also ContextVar propagation across tasks can be surprising.

leo: Two recommended mitigations: (1) dedupe refreshes with an asyncio.Lock or singleflight so only one refresh runs; (2) ensure retry logic re-runs auth before each send instead of reusing prepared request.

maya: I was thinking about moving auth into a transport-level shim or a custom AsyncAuth so headers are applied at send time. But httpx.Auth is sync-focused; might require a transport patch.

sam: Short-term for the SDK: wrap refresh_token with a per-client asyncio.Lock and make retry loop reapply hooks or run auth before each attempt. Long-term: move auth to transport so retries always see fresh headers.

leo: Also the SDK typing needs polish: our Async client types are ambiguous and mypy often treats them like sync clients. We should add an explicit AsyncClient Protocol and proper __aenter__/__aexit__ overloads so `async with` type checks.

maya: I'll add a regression test that races N concurrent requests during token expiry asserting only one refresh and that retried sends use the new token. Will include a FastAPI background-task variant to mirror prod.

ci-bot: created issue #3772 "async auth + retry race -> stale auth headers"

devex: When opening the PR, mark the new test as flaky until CI timing fixtures are added. Add a note to the migration guide about ContextVar vs per-client token storage and recommend per-client lock + transport auth.

maya: Will open draft PR with fixes: (a) per-client lock, (b) retry logic that re-applies auth hooks, and (c) docs example for transport shim.

sam: I'll help with tests. leo, can you prep typing PR to introduce AsyncClient Protocol?

leo: Yes, small separate PR for typings.

maya: Thanks folks — this saved me from chasing intermittent 401s. :rocket:
